verdict.rationale: Docusaurus content lives as plain Markdown/MDX files and config in the user's own repo, and static builds output plain HTML/CSS/JS with no vendor lock-in or account required, as confirmed by a real scaffold roundtrip producing a self-hostable site with no keys/account. Since data is authored and stored as open Markdown/MDX/JSON in git, 'exporting' is essentially just owning your own files already. missing for 10: no explicit first-party 'export/migrate away' guide or bulk-export tool, and no independent evidence of someone exiting to another platform with a documented data-portability workflow.
